name: Relevance
description: How well the response is related to the context and the interesting fact

name: Engagement
description: How engaging and interesting the response is

name: Contextual Understanding
description: How well the response demonstrates understanding of the context

name: Response Adequacy
description: How well the response addresses the question or prompt

name: Conversational Flow
description: How well the response contributes to a natural conversational flow

name: Interestingness
description: How interesting and unique the response is

name: Overall Quality
description: The overall quality of the response
